ev.q: The 2015 suicide rate (13.3) was 28% higher than in 2000.
Age-Adjusted Rate* for Suicide, † by Sex
There was an overall decline of 24% in the age-adjusted suicide rate from 1977 (13.7 per 100,000) to 2000 (10.4).
The 2015 suicide rate (13.3) was 28% higher than in 2000.
the rate for males was approximately 3–5 times higher than the rate for females throughout the study period.
Source: CDC. National Vital Statistics System. Mortality data.
The rate increased in most years from 2000 to 2015.

methods_quotes.q: Age adjusted rates are suicide deaths per 100,000 standard population.
Suicides are identified using International Classification of Diseases (ICD), 8th Revision codes E950–E959 for 1975–1978
